title: Oven-Kissed Russian Kid-Friendly Baked
description: A delightful, kid-friendly Russian dish featuring cider and nuka-pickle, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the eggs, flour, sugar, salt, and black pepper.
Add the nuka-pickle and melted butter to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Pour in the cider and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Transfer the batter to 4-6 mason jars, leaving about 1 inch of space at the top.
Bake the mason jars for 20-25 minutes, or until the edges start to set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove the mason jars from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve the baked goods warm, topped with a dollop of sour cream or a sprinkle of chopped fresh dill, if desired.
Enjoy while still warm, straight from the oven.
Allow to cool completely before refrigerating or freezing.
This recipe makes 4-6 servings and can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days or frozen for up to 2 months.
